entities.name: Khrad
entities.description: Prince of Mon'Telu and mighty Telu-Set warrior from Muraganda who abhors magic and was trained as a magehunter.

entities.name: Star-Sword
entities.description: Inherited white steel weapon of the Telu-Set champion, the sharpest blade on Muraganda.

entities.name: Telu-Set
entities.description: Muragandan people who hate magic and hunt its users.

entities.name: King Khal
entities.description: Khrad's father, who decreed a warrior must stop the beast and Amarth-Tel.

entities.name: Amarth-Tel
entities.description: Ley mage who rode a beast, held Nathala captive and was killed beneath the vehicle's wheels.

entities.name: Chatal
entities.description: Fang Druid who told Khrad the beast was a vehicle and gave him an artifact.

entities.name: Nathala
entities.description: Telu-Set woman of a different tribe held captive by Amarth-Tel who drove the vehicle over him.

entities.name: Tarry Spire
entities.description: Amarth-Tel's lair, which disintegrated after his death.

events.summary: After the Omenpaths open, an oracle prophesies a beast nearing Mon'Telu that Amarth-Tel would seize; King Khal decrees a champion and Khrad steps forth.
events.quote: He was chosen as the champion of his people and set forth on his quest.

events.summary: Khrad catches Amarth-Tel riding the beast with a captive and is easily defeated.
events.quote: However, he was easily defeated by the ley mage.

events.summary: Chatal tells Khrad the beast is a vehicle and gives him an artifact to control it.
events.quote: who told him that the beast was called a vehicle

events.summary: Khrad and Grazak reach the Tarry Spire and Khrad frees Nathala, leaving Grazak to guard her.
events.quote: He cut her from her bindings

events.summary: Khrad and Amarth-Tel fight on the roof; Nathala starts the vehicle with the stolen key and kills Amarth-Tel.
events.quote: Amarth-Tel was killed beneath the vehicle's wheels.

events.summary: Khrad apologizes to Nathala for disregarding her skill and accompanies her study of the vehicle, not returning to Mon'Telu for years.
events.quote: Khrad did not return to Mon'Telu for many years.

relations.quote: He also has a deep bond with his raptor companion

relations.note: ran him over with the vehicle
relations.quote: Amarth-Tel was killed beneath the vehicle's wheels.
Khrad and Amarth-Tel engaged in an epic battle on the roof
